where: Adeptus Custodes · Null Maiden Vigil rule · Silent Sisterhood

source.text:
- When mustering your army, you can select a friendly **ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER** model to be your **WARLORD**.
- Friendly **PROSECUTOR SQUAD** units have **BATTLELINE**.
- Friendly **ANATHEMA PSYKANA** units have the following ability:
**Creeping Dread (Aura):** In the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, each enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is a **PSYKER** unit/below **starting strength** makes a **battle-shock roll**, with -1 to that **battle-shock roll**.
